title: 第9章 不好意思我雕了两尊观音第10章 正式雕师鬼神反噬
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
李浪的木雕被毁，在雕工铺里已经不算是什么秘密。
几乎所有学徒都得知了这个消息，除了在天工坊学习的倪嫣。
对于这个消息，大多数人都是幸灾乐祸。
见不得人好，是大多数人心中的心态，就像是俗话说的，既怕兄弟苦，又怕兄弟开路虎是一个道理。
学徒之间彼此关系甚至没有达到兄弟情的程度，所以大多数学徒都是在幸灾乐祸。
再加上李浪在雕工考核中展现出的技艺，得到双甲上的评分，更是让许多学徒见不得李浪好。
你李浪什么档次，凭什么和天才少女倪嫣一样是双甲上评分？！
倪嫣也感觉到气氛的变化，在轮到李浪取出他的木雕作品时候，那些学徒们脸上的表情，流露出的奚笑、嘲讽还有解气……
这不对劲呀！
这些人难道早就知道李浪的木雕是什么？
亦或者，李浪的木雕……出问题了？
唐宇甚至要忍不住笑出声来，仿佛已经看到李浪取出那被斩首的四目观音镇鬼童像，成为全场笑谈的解气画面。
沙沙——
布帛摩挲过木料组织发出的细微声响，李浪将覆盖在背篓之上的布帛抽开。
面无表情，唇角微抿，双臂探入篓中，青筋都弹起般发力，将木雕从中抱出。
只是刹那间，所有人的目光就都汇聚在了观音像之上。
而刚刚知晓情况的周执事，更是绷着脸，凝重的扫视过去。
嗯？
周执事绷着的脸，很快化开，露出了一抹惊异之色。
倪嫣戴着面纱，那水灵灵的双眸瞪大，仔细盯着木雕，细细打量……

“诶，这也没啥毛病啊？”
“雕刻的很好，你们在笑啥？！”
倪嫣疑惑的开口，大伙在奚笑什么？
他们有资格……奚笑？！
却见，李浪从背篓中扛出的木雕，落在了展示台上。
顶上嵌落的流金水晶，投射下灿烂的光芒，映照李浪的木雕作品，四目观音镇鬼童像。
观音发纱柔顺，青丝垂洒，面庞饱满圆润，其上四只眼角上翘的细长怒目，各自蕴含不同的情绪，有悲悯、冷酷、痛苦……
右手掐住鬼童后脖颈，左手剑指点落鬼童眉心。
那鬼婴童挣扎摆动四肢，其通体皮肤似有蛇鳞般炸起，狰狞且可怖！
灯光之下，雕像被晕染上一层溢散的光辉，仿佛观音复苏、恶童凄厉尖叫！
“周大师、叶大师，我的考核作品【四目观音镇鬼童像】，请品鉴！”
李浪后撤一步，双臂垂落，吐出一口气，轻声道。
“好！”
“以九曲鳞刻技艺雕刻鬼童，对技艺的用法很正确，而观音四目，情绪勾勒十分到位，线条展现雕工基础功底，整体空间构造完整无瑕！
作为学徒，实乃上佳之作！”
“甲上！”
周执事眸光亮起，捋须一笑，赞叹开口，立刻给出了自己的分数。
content_en:
It is no longer a secret in the carving shop that Li Lang's wood carvings were destroyed.
Almost all the apprentices learned the news, except Ni Yan who was studying in Tiangongfang.
Most people were gloating about this news.
The mentality of most people is not to be kind to others. As the saying goes, it is the same reason that they are afraid of their brothers suffering but also afraid of their brothers driving a Land Rover.
The relationship between apprentices does not even reach the level of brotherhood, so most apprentices are just gloating about their misfortunes.
Coupled with the fact that Li Lang's skills in the carving assessment were rated as "Double-A", many apprentices were even more dissatisfied with Li Lang.
What level are you, Li Lang, and why are you rated as high as the talented girl Ni Yan? !
Ni Yan also felt the change in the atmosphere. When it was Li Lang's turn to take out his wood carving work, the expressions on the faces of the apprentices showed ridicule, ridicule and relief...
This is wrong!
Do these people already know what Li Lang's wood carvings are?
Or maybe there's something wrong with Li Lang's wood carving?
Tang Yu even couldn't help but laugh out loud, as if he had seen Li Lang take out the beheaded four-eyed Guanyin Town ghost child statue, which became the scene that relieved the laughter of the whole audience.
rustle——
There was a subtle sound as the cloth rubbed against the wood tissue, and Li Lang pulled away the cloth covering the backpack.
His face was expressionless, his lips were slightly pursed, and he put his arms into the basket, exerting force as if his veins were springing up, and took the wooden sculpture out of it.
In just an instant, everyone's eyes were focused on the Guanyin statue.
Deacon Zhou, who had just learned of the situation, was even more sullen and glanced over solemnly.
Um?
Deacon Zhou's tense face quickly melted away, revealing a look of surprise.
Ni Yan wore a veil, her watery eyes widened, staring at the wood carving carefully, looking at it carefully...
"Hey, there's nothing wrong with that?"
"The carving is very good, what are you laughing at?!"
Ni Yan asked in confusion, what are everyone laughing at?
Are they qualified to... laugh? !
However, he saw that the wooden sculpture Li Lang carried out from his backpack fell on the display stand.
The flowing gold crystal embedded on the top casts brilliant light, reflecting Li Lang's wood carvings, the four-eyed Guanyin statue of the ghost child.
Guanyin's hair is soft and silky, her green silk hair is hanging down, and her face is plump and round. The four slender, angry eyes with upturned corners on her eyes each contain different emotions, including compassion, cruelty, pain...
The right hand pinched the ghost boy's neck, and the sword finger of the left hand touched the ghost boy's eyebrows.
The ghost baby struggled and moved its limbs, and its skin exploded like snake scales. It was ferocious and terrifying!
Under the light, the statue was smudged with a layer of overflowing brilliance, as if Guanyin was resurrected and the evil boy was screaming miserably!
"Master Zhou, Master Ye, please taste my assessment work [Four-Eyed Guanyin Town Ghost Child Statue]!"
Li Lang took a step back, dropped his arms, exhaled, and said softly.
"Okay!"
"The ghost boy was carved using the nine-curved scale carving technique. The usage of the technique is very correct. As for the four eyes of Guanyin, the emotional outline is very good. The lines show the basic skills of the carver. The overall spatial structure is complete!
As an apprentice, this is truly the best work! "
"On top!"
Deacon Zhou's eyes lit up, he smiled, praised, and immediately gave his score.
